title: Chunk
description: One line of a document's .chunks.jsonl file: one piece of the document's text to embed, and what's needed to find it again.

content_hash.description: The file's hash, as records have it.

storage_key.description: The file's name in the council's documents directory: its SHA-256 as hex and an extension.

header.description: The document's title on one line and the section's headings on the next, or less when there isn't both. Put in front of the text when embedding.

headings.description: The headings of the section the text is in, outermost first.

pages.description: The pages the text is on, in order.

embed.description: False for chunks too short to be worth embedding.

text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the text that is embedded: header, a blank line and text, or the text alone.
